what: DERIVATION, independent attempt 1 of 3: Is the rate field's own energy the energy of a clocked amplitude?. SETTING (blocks 53-56; open PRs titled 'ail53: no master clock', 'ail54: a phase timed by the local clock', 'ail55: action and reaction', 'ail56: the strong field, exactly'; all rest on SUPPLIED clauses, not adopted). Rates w_x = phi_x^2 on Z^3; amplitudes timed by them, H_w = phi H phi, so that <H_w> = sum phi_x phi_y h_xy with h_xy = chi_x^dagger H_xy chi_y independent of the rates; the pair keeps a ledger <H_w> + F; with no master clock F has weight one, F = sum over bonds sqrt(w_x w_y) f(u_x - u_y), and through second order every such law is the averaging law for phi = sqrt(w). BLOCK 56, for the simplest member F = (2/gamma) sum over bonds (phi_x - phi_y)^2 in a box with walls held at the ambient rate: at a fixed amplitude the static law is LINEAR in phi, ((12/gamma)(1 - A) + K) phi = 0 with K_xy = Re h_xy (A the average over the six neighbours); for bodies at rest K = diag(m) and the solution is unique with 0 < phi <= 1; the ledger is sum m phi exactly and, for every weight-one bond energy, a sum over wall sites; one body has phi_0 = 1/(1 + x), x = (gamma/12) g_0 m, its ledger stays below 12/(gamma g_0); a region's ledger is bounded by (12/gamma) times its capacity; a pair's ledger falls as the bodies approach at any field strength. BOUNDARY: for the bond energy (1/gamma) sum (w_x - w_y)^2/(w_x + w_y), same second order, the clock at a body stops at the finite bare energy 18/gamma. T5 (a supplied principle): if the field's own energy is bilinear in the root rates, F = sum phi_x J_xy phi_y with J independent of the rates, then nearest-neighbour range, covariance and 'uniform rates solve the empty-space law' leave only c sum over bonds (phi_x - phi_y)^2. TASK: T5's principle says the field's energy is timed the way an amplitude's is. (a) Show that c sum over bonds (phi_x - phi_y)^2 = <xi| phi (c Lambda) phi |xi> with xi the uniform amplitude xi_x = 1 and Lambda the graph operator of sum over bonds (phi_x - phi_y)^2: the field's energy is the clocked energy of a uniform background with a rate-independent generator. (b) Is that a coincidence of notation or a structure? Give the background its own clocked motion, i d(xi)/dt = phi (c Lambda) phi xi, starting uniform: it does not stay uniform when phi varies. Work out what the combined ledger and the static law become if xi is allowed to move (real xi; small deviations), and whether the static results of block 56 survive as the limit in which xi is held uniform. (c) Alternatively take the background to be many amplitudes (a filled set of modes of a rate-independent generator) and compute their clocked energy to second order in the gradient of u: does it have the form c sum sqrt(w_x w_y)(u_x - u_y)^2 with a definite sign of c, and is c then a computed number, which would fix gamma? State clearly what is assumed about the modes that are filled. (d) Say what this would add to the clauses, or that it is only a rewriting. check.py: exact rational checks of (a) on a 3x3x3 torus and a numerical check of (c) on a line.  DELIVERABLE, in your unit worktree on ai/probes: probes/work/derive/the-field-energy-as-a-clocked-amplitude/<your worker name>/ATTEMPT.md and check.py. ATTEMPT.md: (1) the exact statement you attempt; (2) numbered steps, each marked PROVED (argument given in full), CHECKED (a finite fact check.py verifies exactly) or ASSUMED; (3) if the route fails, the FIRST step that fails and why: a precise no-go for a route is a result; (4) what would finish it. check.py: exact arithmetic (fractions, integers, sympy) for every finite claim; it prints `SUMMARY: PROVED ...`, `SUMMARY: COUNTEREXAMPLE ...`, `SUMMARY: PARTIAL <what is new and exact>` or `SUMMARY: ROUTE FAILS AT <step>`, and a line `HIT: <the claim>` ONLY when you claim a proof, a counterexample, or a new exact partial result others can build on; a HIT is handed to a worker of another model family to referee line by line, so write for a hostile reader. Have your own plan BEFORE reading the prior attempts printed at claim time; then either build on a refereed partial result or take a different route.
